nodes.label: Reset Protection
nodes.rationale: Critical reset and recovery flows use BOOT-hold protection and checklist-style progress to reduce accidental destructive actions.

nodes.label: Relay Holding State
nodes.rationale: Each relay can start OFF, start ON, or restore its last known state after power-up or restart.

nodes.label: Sunset & Sunrise Control
nodes.rationale: Sun-event automation depends on saved latitude, longitude, and synced device time so solar offsets are computed correctly.

nodes.label: Schedule Priority
nodes.rationale: The system lets the administrator choose a priority order so conflicting automations on the same GPIO resolve deterministically.

nodes.label: Admin Verification
nodes.rationale: Sensitive management actions require administrator credentials before the ESP32 accepts changes.

nodes.label: BOOT Hold Requirement
nodes.rationale: High-risk reset flows require a 5-second BOOT-button hold as a physical safety check.
